settings.account_token_desc: Required for the assets and performance audits. Generate one from your SeaTable account settings.
settings.verify_urls_desc: When enabled, external URLs are checked via HEAD requests during the audit. This can significantly increase audit time.
settings.no_settings_links: No settings available for the Links audit.
settings.audit_all_cols: Audit all columns regardless of views
settings.row_archival_stale_tooltip: Click to rerun — or use the button above the Tables audit.
settings.login_disclaimer: Your credentials are sent directly to your SeaTable server and are not stored.
settings.account_token_perf_desc: Required for sandbox testing. Generate one from your SeaTable account settings.

assets.error_no_token: Error: No account token configured. Please add it in Settings.
assets.configure_token: Please configure your account token in Settings to run the assets audit.
assets.missing_refs_desc: path(s) in rows pointing to deleted files

orphans.title: Orphaned assets ({count})
orphans.delete_warning: Deleted assets cannot be recovered. Snapshots do not include files. Before deleting, consider exporting your base with the "include assets" option checked to keep a full backup. Please make sure the files listed here are no longer needed before deleting them.

external_urls.title: External URLs ({count})
external_urls.verify_desc: — check external URLs for broken links via HEAD requests
external_urls.no_broken_group: No broken URLs to remove in this group

tables.view_rows_hint: Rows displayed — from the most recent Performance analysis.
tables.col_compute_hint: Share of total compute time — from the most recent Performance analysis.
tables.col_matches_ctime: matches created time — use ctime column?

links.no_links_found: No link columns found in this base.
links.check_lookups_desc: — compares manual columns against linked records to detect potential lookups
links.no_suggestions: No suggestions — all manual columns contain unique data

performance.no_candidates: No performance candidates detected — base looks clean.
performance.error_no_token: Account token required for sandbox testing. Configure it in Settings.
performance.delta_tooltip: Change in theoretical compute cost per view (Σ per-cell × visible rows). Big views weight more naturally — no extra row-count factor needed.
performance.minor_views_hidden: +{count} minor views hidden (each <{threshold}% of total view-load weight).
performance.minor_candidates_hidden: +{count} minor columns hidden (each <{threshold}% of total compute).
performance.view_rows_tooltip: Rows returned by this view (after filters), out of total rows in the table.
performance.view_weight_tooltip: Share of total view-load time (rowCount × ms). Deleting removes this view as a switching destination but doesn't reduce overall base compute work.
performance.archival_hint: {count} archivable rows in {table} — archiving may reduce this view
performance.apply_warning: Apply these changes to the original base? A snapshot will be created first, but deleted columns cannot be restored from within the plugin.
performance.applied_changes: Applied changes: {count} column(s) remediated in original base
performance.applied_with_errors: Applied {applied} change(s); {failed} failed — see browser console for details
performance.ruleless_views_title: {count} view(s) will have no rules remaining
performance.ruleless_views_hint: Without any filter/sort/group-by, these views will show an unfiltered dump of their table. You can delete them instead.
performance.copy_modal_title: Create a sandbox with these changes?
performance.sandbox_failed_label: {count} change(s) failed — see browser console for details.
performance.affected_rules_tooltip: Rules across the base that reference this column
performance.replace_disabled_multi: Cannot replace — some rows return multiple values
performance.replace_disabled_type: Cannot determine a safe replacement type
performance.delete_disabled_primary: Cannot delete — this is the table's first column
performance.benchmark_caveat: Theoretical compute cost compared before/after, summed across views. Filter/sort/group cost, DOM rendering and network sync aren't included — actual editor responsiveness may differ.
performance.cost_tooltip: Share of total formula compute time across all formula columns.
performance.tag_structural_tooltip: High cost per row — the formula itself is expensive. Will get worse as the table grows. Action: rewrite the formula.
performance.tag_volume_tooltip: Low cost per row but high total cost — the formula is fine, the table just has many rows. Action: archive or filter rows.
performance.concentration_high: Top 5 columns account for {pct}% of total compute — a few columns dominate.
performance.concentration_low: Top 5 columns account for only {pct}% of total compute — cost is spread broadly.
performance.full_copy_hint: Uses export/import instead of quick copy. Slower but preserves everything — needed if you want to test automations or scripts in the sandbox.
performance.private_view_tooltip: Private view (owner: {owner}). Visible only to its owner; the SDK may still let you delete it.
performance.run_analysis_hint: Benchmarks the base, measures per-column formula cost, sizes every view, and opens the test/sandbox workflow. Takes 30s or more on large bases.
performance.no_archival_candidates: No archival candidates found — all tables are active.
performance.rows_archival_tooltip: Rows whose creation and modification times are both older than the archival threshold.
performance.rows_safe_tooltip: Archival candidates not referenced by any link column in any other table — safest to archive first.
performance.archival_delete_no_rows: No archival rows to delete on "{table}".
performance.archival_delete_warning: These rows will be permanently deleted. A snapshot is taken first so you can restore the table data if needed. Note: snapshots back up rows but NOT asset files (uploaded images, attachments).
performance.archival_delete_body: {count} row(s) in "{table}" have not been created or modified since the audit threshold. Linked rows are NOT excluded — review the "safe" subset in the row if you only want to delete unreferenced rows.
performance.archival_delete_snapshot_failed: Snapshot failed — aborting deletion of archival rows on "{table}".
performance.archival_delete_failed: Failed to delete archival rows on "{table}": {error}
performance.archival_view_create_failed: Failed to create archival view on {table}: {error}
performance.archival_col_add_failed: Failed to add date column on {table}: {error}
performance.archival_view_weaker_filter: View created on "{table}" with a weaker filter — only one of created/modified time is available.
performance.archival_view_not_created_no_columns: No archival view created on "{table}" — date columns required.
performance.archival_modal_title_one: Add the missing date column to "{table}"?
performance.archival_modal_body_one: "{table}" has only the {existing} column. Add {missing} for a stricter filter (rows older than the threshold on BOTH timestamps), or skip to create the view with the single available filter.
performance.archival_modal_body_both: "{table}" has no created-time or last-modified column. Adding both lets the new view filter rows by age. The columns are based on built-in row metadata — no data loss.
performance.archival_modal_skip: Skip and create with weaker filter
performance.unselect_table: Unselect all columns in this table
performance.label_volume: volume cost (large table, low cost per row)
performance.label_near_duplicate_tooltip: These columns share the same compute (same link, source field, and aggregation) — only their display config differs. Each one re-does the same work. Keep one and delete the rest to recover the duplicate compute.
performance.rows_archival_tooltip_combined: Rows whose creation and modification times are both older than the archival threshold. "Safe" rows are not referenced by any link column elsewhere — safest to archive first.
performance.rows_archival_tooltip_stale: Row count changed since the last performance analysis — these archival figures may be outdated.
performance.rows_archival_tooltip_deleted: These rows were deleted since the last performance analysis. Counts will refresh on the next performance rerun.
performance.archival_scope_safe: Only {count} safe row(s) — not referenced by any other table.
performance.archival_scope_all: All {count} row(s) — including {referenced} referenced from other tables (those references will be cleared).
performance.section_subtitle_archival: Archiving old rows reduces compute time on every view.
performance.rows_base_impact_tooltip: Share of total base rows this table's archival candidates represent. Higher = more performance impact if archived.
performance.rows_belowthreshold_footer: +{count} table(s) with fewer than {threshold} archival candidates — see individual table tabs for details.
performance.views_to_delete_mixed_title: {forced} view(s) staged for deletion + {ruleless} that will become rule-less
performance.view_forced_tooltip: Staged for deletion as part of this test case.
performance.stage_not_relevant_tooltip: Not significant — staging this won't measurably improve performance.
performance.stage_all_views: Stage all relevant views in this table
performance.unstage_all_views: Unstage all views in this table
performance.stage_all_views_no_relevant: No views in this table are significant enough to stage.
performance.sandbox_partial_failures: {failed} change(s) failed to apply to the sandbox — see browser console.
performance.sandbox_orphaned: Sandbox "{name}" was created but the test it belonged to is gone. Open it from your SeaTable workspace.
performance.hide_drill_title: Visible in {count} view(s) — hide where not needed:
performance.hide_rule_bound_tooltip: Referenced by {kinds} in this view. Hiding doesn't reduce compute cost — the value is still needed to evaluate the rule.
performance.manage_visibility_hint: Toggle to plan changes; commit via the three-dots menu.
performance.visibility_apply_failed: Failed to update visibility for view "{view}".
performance.visibility_stage_no_adds: Stage only commits new hides — nothing to stage. Use Apply for un-hides.
performance.visibility_staged_mixed: {staged} hide(s) staged for "{view}"; {dropped} un-hide(s) discarded — use Apply for those.
performance.col_visibility_staged_mixed: {staged} hide(s) staged for "{col}"; {dropped} un-hide(s) discarded — use Apply for those.
performance.col_visibility_stage_no_adds: Stage only commits new hides — nothing to stage. Use Apply for un-hides.
